description: This file defines custom Jest matchers for testing thrown errors, including functions to compare error messages, types, and stack traces. It exports matcher functions like 'toThrow' and 'toThrowError'.

methods.name: createMatcher
methods.description: Creates a Jest matcher function for error throwing assertions, supporting various expected value types.

methods.name: toThrowExpectedRegExp
methods.description: Checks if the thrown error message matches a given RegExp.

methods.name: toThrowExpectedAsymmetric
methods.description: Checks if the thrown error matches an asymmetric matcher.

methods.name: toThrowExpectedObject
methods.description: Checks if the thrown error matches an expected Error object.

methods.name: toThrowExpectedClass
methods.description: Checks if the thrown error is an instance of a specific class.

methods.name: toThrowExpectedString
methods.description: Checks if the thrown error message includes a specific substring.

methods.name: toThrow
methods.description: Checks if a function throws an error.

methods.name: formatExpected
methods.description: Formats the expected value for display in messages.

methods.name: formatReceived
methods.description: Formats the received value for display in messages, with special handling for error messages.

methods.name: formatStack
methods.description: Formats the stack trace of an error if available.

methods.name: createMessageAndCauseMessage
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an error message and its cause chain.

methods.name: createMessageAndCause
methods.description: Returns the message string of an error, including its cause chain.

methods.name: messageAndCause
methods.description: Determines whether to include 'message' or 'message and cause' based on error's cause property.
